Resolve One Key of a Simulation's par

Source: R/rstatmod.R
resolve_par_key.Rd

Turns a name into the vector and the positions it addresses.

Usage

resolve_par_key(key, params, cn, snm)

Arguments

key

The name.

params

The distribution parameter names.

cn

A named list of coefficient names, one per parameter.

snm

The structural parameter names, or NULL.

Value

A list with space, param and pos.

Details

The order is exact matches first and groups after, so a name that is both a coefficient and the stem of others addresses the coefficient. A group is recognized at a dot rather than by any prefix, since a coefficient name is free to begin with the letters of another.

A key that reaches nothing is reported with what the model does carry. Guessing would be worse than refusing: a misspelled name would leave the quantity drawn and the caller would read a simulation of another model.

See also

rstatmod_named()
